closure_evidence.product: N/A -- host infrastructure restore, no product surface changed
closure_evidence.technical: Root cause: ai.sirsi.gemma-broker launchd job was not bootstrapped (launchctl print returned 'could not find service'); `sirsi gemma serve` only kickstarts an already-loaded job (exit 113 when absent), so it could not self-heal. Not the quarantine marker (.plist.quarantined absent), not RAM (22GB free/48GB total), not missing weights (HF cache present).
closure_evidence.operational: Fixed via `launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.sirsi.gemma-broker.plist` (job now state=running) and restoring ~/.sirsi/gemma-server.port (8477), which an earlier `sirsi gemma serve --stop` in this same triage had deleted, causing a false 'unavailable' status read.
closure_evidence.narrative: Alert was accurate (broker down); action taken matches the item's own instructions (right-size/restore, never kill-by-name) since the process at the label is sne-server (Go/mlx), not the retired Python gemma path.
